page.layout: One printed page (p. 145), one column of text, with no margin notes on this page. The left strip is the edge of the facing page and is not transcribed. Reading order: chapter head (full width), "Argumentatio." and SECT. I. with the paragraph below, the numbered thesis line, SECT. II. with its paragraph, then the catchword at the foot.

main_text.l: QUod, cùm homini offertur, necessariò contumeliosum est, id
non potest non esse ei contumeliosum: Ergò,
Ethicum seu Morale, nec non lumine
LOca Scripturarum plurima sunt: nos delectum

page.notes: The left strip shows the right-hand margin of the facing page (partly visible notes such as "nos", "ali-", "est,", "uis", "ve-"). It is cut off by the binding and is not transcribed. The final line of the text is cut short by the catchword "quorum", which is the word that continues on the next page.
